slides.title: Ethiopia orders 6 Sudanese diplomats to leave Assosa
What was reported
slides.body: A senior Ethiopian official told Reuters: leave within 48 hours.

slides.title: Reason not given
slides.body: The official gave no reason. The PM's office had not responded.

slides.title: Sudan's view
slides.body: An adviser says Sudan wants to avoid open confrontation with Ethiopia. Both sides deny the other's claims.

slides.title: Dialogue, not escalation.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Reuters via Addis Standard · Nov 4, 2026
